title: Category 1 improvements approved by the owner (implement later)
why: Owner approved all four on 17 Oct 2026, to implement later: (1) gate/private road at the trip's own start or finish: ask the driver once and remember per place; (2) time-limited (:conditional) road rules evaluated against the clock instead of always closed (needs the offline-package fix, category 17); (3) check the 5 no-legal-route junctions on Mapillary photos and fix OSM if wrong; (4) driver corrections for turns allowed/banned and gates open, overriding map data. App changes need the private DriveMate repo; research checks here first.
